name: Disable Samsung TV Plus
description: 1.2.0 suppresses slive-provider-daemon with the vendor opt-out file plus systemctl stop instead of leaving it running: the unit gates on ConditionPathExists=!/opt/usr/share/systemd/system/slive-provider-daemon, stop-only was press-tested instant, and no mask is ever applied to it (masking a bus-name owner is the measured cause of the 2-3 s remote-key dead zone). TV Plus itself stays off through db/menu/autorun_tv_plus=0, the bstr_tvplus_mode boot flag, the bms and slive-util masks and the standalone-app kill sweep.
author: Clément Péron
